reconstructed_theorem_text: For every normed real inner-product Borel space E with second-countable topology, every real kappa at least one, and arbitrary measures mu and nu on E times E, the square of the ordinary Samplinglib Wasserstein distance between mu and nu is at most ENNReal.ofReal 6 times phaseWassersteinSq kappa mu nu. The factor six is independent of kappa and dimension, and the statement assumes neither probability laws, finiteness, nor an optimal coupling.
objects: Samplinglib ordinary W2 squared and phaseWassersteinSq for the same two measures.
domains: Any second-countable real inner-product Borel space and arbitrary measures.
quantifiers: Every kappa>=1 and every pair of measures.
assumptions: Borel and second-countable structure exposes measurability; no optimizer or finiteness premise.
conclusion: W2 squared is at most six times the twisted squared transport value.
scopes: No D.3, history, contraction, query moment, or main theorem.
constant_dependencies: The explicit universal constant is 6, independent of kappa and dimension.
